title: Thirumoorthy
desc: Murthy, a truck driver, fights against a corrupt politician, Sigamani, and contests in the elections against one of his aides. However, things take a turn when he becomes a murder suspect.

title: Annai Abirami
desc: Abirami, a young girl, rejects every marriage proposal her widowed mother brings for her. Soon, this leads to the tragic death of the latter which changes her life.

title: Varusham 16
desc: Kannan, a teenager, falls in love with his uncle's daughter, Radhika, but things turn upside down when her grandmother disapproves of their relationship.

title: University
desc: A man and a woman connect with each other through a wrong number. Though they talk over the phone regularly and fall in love, they are unaware of the other's identity.

title: Rendu
desc: Sakthi moves to the city in search of a job. However, he lands in trouble when a CBI officer mistakes him for a serial killer who is his doppelgänger.
